reading.title: Vegetables 1: Planning Meals with Vegetables
reading.text: A shopper plans several meals and compares vegetables at the market. For roasting and soups, the list includes carrot, potato, sweet potato, beet, and turnip. For salads and greens, the shopper checks radish, parsnip, ginger, yam, and rutabaga. For a cooked main dish, the options include lettuce, spinach, kale, arugula, and cabbage. The shopper chooses fresh items and avoids buying more than needed.
